name: 4-FMA
addictionPotential: moderately addictive with a high potential for abuse
summary: A stimulant with some empathogenic properties, and analogue of Methamphetamine with similar effects. Reported to be less effective than 2-FMA and related compounds. Little is known about the pharmacological effects of this compound. Not to be confused with 4-FA, which has a different effect profile, despite similar potency.

tolerance.buildUp: develops with prolonged and repeated use

pharmacology.text: 4-FMA is a CYP450 inhibitor. It reduces the metabolism of methamphetamine, which has the effect of increasing its potency, duration and systemic toxicity while also reducing its cellular toxicity.

uses.text: It has been reported to be sold as a designer drug, but little is known about its pharmacology or toxicology. It was first detected from legal highs sold in Japan in 2006 and became illegal to sell or to possess for the purpose of distribution (although not to simply possess for personal use) in Japan in 2008.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the substituted amphetamines, can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, overheating, jaw clenching, loss of appetite, insomnia, anxiety and a low mood afterwards. Serious risks include heart problems, stroke, psychosis and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的取代安非他命類藥物，可能引起心跳急促、血壓升高、體溫過高、咬緊牙關、食慾不振、失眠、焦慮，以及藥效過後的情緒低落。嚴重風險包括心臟問題、中風、精神病與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的取代安非他命类药物，可能引起心跳急促、血压升高、体温过高、咬紧牙关、食欲不振、失眠、焦虑，以及药效过后的情绪低落。严重风险包括心脏问题、中风、精神病与成瘾。

fact.en: 4-FMA has the same structure as methamphetamine apart from a single fluorine atom on the benzene ring. That one atom shifts its effects enough that some users describe it as partly empathogenic.
fact.zh: 4-FMA的結構和甲基安非他命幾乎一樣，只是苯環上多了一個氟原子。就這麼一個原子，就讓它的作用改變到一些使用者形容它帶有部分同理心增強的感覺。
fact.zhHans: 4-FMA的结构和甲基安非他命几乎一样，只是苯环上多了一个氟原子。就这么一个原子，就让它的作用改变到一些用户形容它带有部分同理心增强的感觉。
